profile.headline: Software Developer | JavaScript | React | Node.js | mongodb | PostgreSQL | Powered by weightlifting, dog-cuddles, & anime
profile.summary:
I’m a software developer who got here through people. After about seven years traveling the world and working alongside non-profits and humanitarian aid programs, I’m bringing that same drive to building technology that makes people’s lives genuinely better and brings real human connection back to an AI-saturated world. 

Before this, I was a Software QA Engineer Lead at Markful, where I wrote test strategies, trained and mentored a QA team, and worked with our senior developer/DevOps lead to ship reliable releases. That QA mindset shapes how I build: I think about the person on the other side of the screen, what could go wrong for them, and how to make their experience faster and easier. 

I work with JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, SQL, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, and Bootstrap. I graduated from the Austin Community College Software Developer Bootcamp in September 2026. My capstone, DogDex (dogdex.live), is a mobile-first app for spotting and collecting dog breeds, built with React, Node, MongoDB, Clerk, and Cloudinary. 

I’m passionate about servant leadership: helping people take ownership of their role and gain the confidence of a leader themselves. At Markful, I trained and mentored junior QA engineers, and I love sharing what I know to pass on the leg-up others gave me. To me, a title doesn’t make someone a leader. Character, integrity, how you treat people, and thoughtful, empowering communication do. I enjoy finding solutions that address social issues and real user pain points, and I’m looking for a frontend or full-stack role on a team with a clear mission to improve people’s lives. I like replacing messy manual processes with systems that make work easier for the next person. I’ve done it at a welding company and a small business, and now I do it with code. 

I'm grateful amazing virtual and in-person communities exist, and I'm very active in the Dallas Software Developer Group, 100Devs, and Austin Women in Technology communities.

Outside of work: I love working out at functional fitness gyms, cozy video games, psychological thriller audiobooks, my husband, and our German Shepherd, Emma.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was overjoyed to volunteer for the Commit Your Code Conference 2026. It was an honor helping to support the speakers. In my volunteer role, I helped each speaker put on their lapel mics and stay within their allotted time slot. I absolutely loved meeting and encouraging each speaker before they went on, and then leading the applause of the room after. I enjoyed getting to know my fellow volunteers and helping where ever else I could for all of Day 1. CYC Conference was an overall wonderful experience to be a part of. I loved learning about tech I hadn't been exposed to yet, and broadening my experience with AI Engineering. Most of all, I enjoyed meeting tons of people in person that belong to multiple virtual tech communities that I have been a part of for several years.

At Frontend Queens, we're on a mission to empower and elevate women in the world of frontend development. Our community is a vibrant hub where aspiring and experienced frontend developers come together to learn, grow, and thrive.


What sets us apart? We believe in the power of representation and support. In an industry where women are underrepresented, we're here to change the narrative. Through mentorship, networking events, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions, we provide the resources and support needed to help women excel in frontend development.

http://www.frontendqueens.com/

projects.title: Property Bill Automation
projects.description:
As a member of the Dallas Software Developers Group 6-week cohort, myself and 6 other team members are building a solution to a significant problem a property management company is experiencing. The solution we're collaborating on is an app that helps more easily and efficiently track and pay hundreds of bills across hundreds of properties. 

We are utilizing MongoDB, Express, Node, React, Figma, Jira, and AI automation decisions to build this application.

projects.title: DogDex
projects.description:
DogDex is a mobile-first web appplication for dog lovers who want to discover, track, and learn about dog breeds they encounter in real life. Inspired by bird-watching and the beloved Pokédex concept, DogDex lets users browse a complete encyclopedia of recognized dog breeds, check off the ones they've spotted in the wild, and log each sighting with a photo, location, and personal notes. A Breed of the Day feature reveals a new breed on the home screen every morning, giving users a daily reason to open the app and learn something new.

DogDex turns every walk, dog park visit, or trip to the neighborhood into an opportunity for discovery and connection with fellow dog lovers — making it equal parts hobby tracker, educational tool, and collection game.

Utilized and enforced risk assessment practices for all factors concerning California's Power Grid and to maintain the business continuity of this corporate office holding over 700 staff members.

Assisted in planning and leading fire safety drills. Built safety equipment and props for emergency preparedness. 

Edited and formatted a 750 page playbook for the annual GridEx V, the largest testing event in North America.

positions.title: Mail Room & Campus Operations Office Assistant
positions.description:
Managed and meticulously organized the mail room, and customer-facing mail services office.

Sorted and delivered mail efficiently everyday for over 700 employees.

Collaborated with the whole facilities team to accomplish daily ticketed tasks, such as setting up for events, configuring meeting rooms per client specifications, setting up AV equipment for large stakeholders meetings, and setting up work stations for new hires, increasing productivity and efficiency by 85%.

Utilized QuickBooks Desktop Pro and Online to precisely record and reconcile income and expenses for six clients, achieving a 98% accuracy rate in financial reports.

Partnered with clients to deliver financial insights derived from bookkeeping data, contributing to a 15% increase in business profitability.

Managed payroll processing for four clients, guaranteeing punctual and correct employee payments, and decreasing errors by 15%.

Performed thorough analyses of financial discrepancies identified during monthly bank reconciliations, culminating in a 95% reduction in errors.

experience.title: Barista

Created a welcoming environment with many happy repeat customers as I memorized their names and treated them with genuine care and compassion. 

Executed precise cash handling procedures, ensuring 100% accuracy in all transactions and compliance with company policies, resulting in zero discrepancies during cash audits.

Implemented and optimized automated software solution for invoice and payroll processing systems, resulting in a 90% reduction in processing time, saving the company 100 hours per month.

Developed and designed a multi-page dynamic website utilizing a CDN. Launched a social media page, increasing traffic by 85% and leads from 0 to 15 per week.

Developed and implemented efficient filing systems to improve document organization and retrieval.

Managed all financial transactions and maintained accurate records using QuickBooks software.

Performed daily bookkeeping tasks, including recording sales and expenses, reconciling bank statements, and processing payroll.

Collaborated with accountants to ensure timely and accurate preparation of tax returns.

Setup network equipment for the office such as routers, switches, and access points.

Installed and configured operating systems, applications, and drivers on desktops and laptops.

Performed routine maintenance tasks including system updates, virus scans, and data backups.

Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team including therapists, case managers, and educators to coordinate comprehensive care for residents, addressing their specific needs and goals.

Maintained accurate documentation of residents' progress, behaviors, incidents, and interventions in accordance with agency policies.

Supported residents in daily living activities such as meal planning/preparation, personal hygiene routines, and medication management.

Provided crisis intervention services during emergencies or escalated situations to ensure the safety of residents and staff members.

Implemented behavior management techniques based on positive reinforcement strategies to encourage pro-social behaviors among residents.

volunteerExperience.description: I was overjoyed to volunteer for the Commit Your Code Conference 2026. It was an honor helping to support the speakers. In my volunteer role, I helped each speaker put on their lapel mics and stay within their allotted time slot. I absolutely loved meeting and encouraging each speaker before they went on, and then leading the applause of the room after. I enjoyed getting to know my fellow volunteers and helping where ever else I could for all of Day 1. CYC Conference was an overall wonderful experience to be a part of. I loved learning about tech I hadn't been exposed to yet, and broadening my experience with AI Engineering. Most of all, I enjoyed meeting tons of people in person that belong to multiple virtual tech communities that I have been a part of for several years.

At Frontend Queens, we're on a mission to empower and elevate women in the world of frontend development. Our community is a vibrant hub where aspiring and experienced frontend developers come together to learn, grow, and thrive.


What sets us apart? We believe in the power of representation and support. In an industry where women are underrepresented, we're here to change the narrative. Through mentorship, networking events, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions, we provide the resources and support needed to help women excel in frontend development.

http://www.frontendqueens.com/
